newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Fairfax says supports AAPT float.
newsitem.headline: Fairfax says supports AAPT float.

text.p: John Fairfax Holdings Ltd said on Tuesday it would support a float of AAPT Telecommunications Pty Ltd in which it is an indirect shareholding.
Asked if Fairfax supported an AAPT float, finance director John Greaves said: "Most definitely."
"I think we could see it (float decision) well within the next 12 months," Greaves said.
He said the AAPT board was to meet in the next couple of weeks over the float.
AAPT, Australia's third largest telecoms group, has said it was considering a equity capital raising.
AAPT is 51 percent owned by AAP Information Services Pty Ltd (AAPIS), operator of newsagency Australian Associated Press.
AAPIS's major shareholders are John Fairfax and The News Corp Ltd.
Singapore Telecommunications Ltd and the unlisted Todd Corp of New Zealand are the minority shareholders in AAPT with 24.5 percent each.
